div.div: زَفُونٌ , applied to a she-camel, i. q. زَبُونٌ [That pushes, or thrusts, or that pushes, or thrusts, away, or that kicks, or strikes, and pushes, &c., her milker with her hind leg, or with her stiflejoint; or that is wont, or accustomed, to do so]: or lame; as also ↓ زَافِنَةٌ ; (K;) as though she danced in her gait, in consequence of lameness. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
